### Libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(car)
library(lme4)
library(nlme)
library(DHARMa)
library(rgl)
library(remef)
```

### Load data and create factors
```{r}
# intrastim_correlation = read.csv("~/These/data/meg_maestro/representation_analysis/seeg/csv_correlations/similarity_matrix_medial_temporal_similarity.csv")
# intrastim_correlation = read.csv("~/These/data/meg_maestro/representation_analysis/seeg/csv_correlations/similarity_matrix_hippocampus_similarity.csv")
intrastim_correlation = read.csv("~/These/data/meg_maestro/representation_analysis/seeg/csv_correlations/similarity_matrix_channels_Left-Hippocampus_similarity.csv")
intrastim_correlation$onset = as.factor(intrastim_correlation$onset)
intrastim_correlation$rate = as.factor(intrastim_correlation$rate)
```

### Visualizations
```{r}
# scatterplotMatrix(~correct + correlation + onset + rate + surprise, data=intrastim_correlation)
hist(intrastim_correlation$correct)
hist(intrastim_correlation$correlation)
hist(intrastim_correlation$surprise)
hist(intrastim_correlation$positive_surprise)
```

### intrastim correlation and correct
The first three lines assess whether random effects are needed
```{r}
correct = glmer(correct ~ correlation + (1|subject), data = intrastim_correlation, family = binomial(link='logit'))
AIC(correct)
correct = glmer(correct ~ correlation + rate + (1|subject), data = intrastim_correlation, family = binomial(link='logit'))
AIC(correct)
correct = glmer(correct ~ correlation + onset + (1|subject), data = intrastim_correlation, family = binomial(link='logit'))
AIC(correct)
correct = glmer(correct ~ correlation + onset + rate + (1|subject), data = intrastim_correlation, family = binomial(link='logit'))
AIC(correct)
correct = glmer(correct ~ correlation + onset + rate + (1|subject) + (1 | subject:channel), data = intrastim_correlation, family = binomial(link='logit'))
AIC(correct)

correct = glmer(correct ~ correlation + onset + rate + (1|subject), data = intrastim_correlation, family = binomial(link='logit'))
summary(correct)
```

### surprise and intrastim correlation
The first three lines assess whether random effects are needed
```{r}

correct = lmer(correlation ~ surprise + (1|subject), data = intrastim_correlation)
AIC(correct)
correct = lmer(correlation ~ surprise + onset + (1|subject), data = intrastim_correlation)
AIC(correct)
correct = lmer(correlation ~ surprise + rate + (1|subject), data = intrastim_correlation)
AIC(correct)
correct = lmer(correlation ~ surprise + onset + rate + (1|subject), data = intrastim_correlation)
AIC(correct)
correct = lmer(correlation ~ surprise + onset + rate + (1|subject) + (1 | subject:channel), data = intrastim_correlation)
AIC(correct)

correct = lmer(correlation ~ surprise + onset + rate + (1|subject), data = intrastim_correlation)
summary(correct)
correct = lmer(correlation ~ surprise + onset + rate + (1|subject) + (1 | subject:channel), data = intrastim_correlation)
summary(correct)
```

## Interstimulus correlation
### Load data and create factors
```{r}
# interstim_correlation = read.csv("~/These/data/meg_maestro/representation_analysis/seeg/csv_correlations/similarity_matrix_medial_temporal_dissimilarity.csv")
# interstim_correlation = read.csv("~/These/data/meg_maestro/representation_analysis/seeg/csv_correlations/similarity_matrix_hippocampus_dissimilarity.csv")
interstim_correlation = read.csv("~/These/data/meg_maestro/representation_analysis/seeg/csv_correlations/similarity_matrix_channels_Left-Hippocampus_dissimilarity.csv")
interstim_correlation$rep = as.factor(interstim_correlation$rep)
interstim_correlation$onset = as.factor(interstim_correlation$onset)
interstim_correlation$rate = as.factor(interstim_correlation$rate)
```

### Visualizations
```{r}
# scatterplotMatrix(~correct + correlation + rep + onset + rate + surprise, data=interstim_correlation)
hist(interstim_correlation$correct)
hist(interstim_correlation$correlation)
hist(interstim_correlation$surprise)
hist(interstim_correlation$positive_surprise)
```

### intrastim correlation and correct
The first three lines assess whether random effects are needed

```{r}
AIC(correct)
correct = glmer(correct ~ correlation + rep + onset + (1|subject), data = interstim_correlation, family = binomial(link='logit'))
AIC(correct)
correct = glmer(correct ~ correlation + rep + rate + (1|subject), data = interstim_correlation, family = binomial(link='logit'))
AIC(correct)
correct = glmer(correct ~ correlation + rep + onset + rate + (1|subject), data = interstim_correlation, family = binomial(link='logit'))
AIC(correct)
correct = glmer(correct ~ correlation + rep + onset + rate + (1|subject) + (1 | subject:channel), data = interstim_correlation, family = binomial(link='logit'))
AIC(correct)

correct = glmer(correct ~ correlation + rep + onset + rate + (1|subject), data = interstim_correlation, family = binomial(link='logit'))
summary(correct)
```
